assessment_scope.source_boundary: Only konosuba:vanir@original-light-novel#current-monograph, the active_provisional SECONDARY_VANIR_EXPANDED_V1 monograph at basis_commit, read in full as reviewed repository analysis of accepted main and supplemental histories through the MAIN17 excluded-component closure, with seven MASK BASE-TEXT units and bounded MAIN07 joins rechecked by its author. The KonoSuba CURRENT_STATE_AND_CORPUS_MAP.md was read for method, authority order and scope only. The linked KONOSUBA_VANIR_RECONSTRUCTION_MODEL.md, the Vanir evidence index, the readings, ledgers, reports and the Japanese source are not curated evidence on this subject and nothing is borrowed from them; the monograph's own 'scoped Tier 3 reconstruction candidate' label is an input, not a conclusion. No exhaustive appearance census, image, audio or primary-source inspection is included.
assessment_scope.temporal_boundary: Separate episode families kept apart: the MASK human-Wiz origin encounter, the MAIN03 dungeon possession and lost life, the MAIN04 commercial proposal, the MAIN07 financing and Alderp collection, the MASK shop, guild, royal-outing and succubus episodes, and later main, Dust and Yorimichi boundary checks through MAIN17. Publication order is not in-world date, no default present state is fixed, and the number of remaining lives, the completed dungeon and any announced future restitution or punishment are outside this assessment.
assessment_scope.assessment_method: characters/RECONSTRUCTION_CAPABILITY_SPEC.md and governance/policies/CHARACTER_RECONSTRUCTION_MAINTENANCE.md at basis_commit; evidence-located calibration with countercases, explicit gaps and no model-readiness inheritance.

dimensions.note: The monograph argues a motive structure of dungeon ambition, discriminated taste for negative emotion (MAIN07 C5 P234-236, I P93-104), particular company with Wiz (MASK U011 P23-43, U015 P456-518) and contractual pride, and rejects four rival models by named adverse cases. C was rejected because it gives no conditional rules or selectors (those live in the uncurated model) and states that attachment versus dependence, pride versus reputation and pleasure versus profit are not isolated. E was rejected because the argued structure spans many located episodes.

The chronology section separates the MASK origin, MAIN03, MAIN04, MAIN07, MASK shop episodes and later material, and refuses to let one final benevolent or malicious identity replace earlier motives. C was rejected because no state sequence, default or rollback is given and publication order is not in-world order. E was rejected because the phase separation is explicit.

Written 我輩, elevated declaratives and performed laughter; 貴公 and polished reintroduction with Maxwell versus contempt for Alderp; a customer-service formulation at MAIN07 C5 P313; and portable mechanisms of anticipatory interruption, client classification and strategic disclosure. C was rejected because the treatment is one section with few exact forms and no inventory, and written stance establishes no timing or laugh frequency. E was rejected because recipient-specific contrasts are located.

Shop work with inventory, prices, spoilage, capital, customer fit and staffing; actual holy-water sales beside later loss; choosing rest over a proposed attack; and distinctions among requested, imagined and offered fees. C was rejected because most ordinary conduct is generalized rather than located scene by scene. E was rejected because the shop economy is analyzed as a pressure test with limits.

Recipient-specific conduct is located for Wiz (refused depleted soul price at MASK U021 P379-492, U011 exclusion refused, U015 court offer declined then sought), Maxwell (fellow duke, bows and reintroductions), Alderp (engineered disappointment), Kazuma (presumptive handling and information asymmetry, MAIN07 C5 P200-222), Iris (U015 P88-151), Luna, the succubi (U019 P418-647) and Aqua. B was rejected because the motive balance in each relation is not isolated and the evidence is one artifact. D was rejected because many relations are differentiated with located conduct.

The origin episode is Wiz's first person and the MAIN07 interlude is Alderp's; the monograph mentions Vanir's own later first person and stated reasons (naming both dream and friend) but keeps each account attributed and warns that others' views grant no access to his private calculations. D was rejected because direct interior access is sparse and mostly reported. NOT_ASSESSED was rejected because his own stated reasons are located.

Located conflict includes renewed provocation of Aqua after reconstitution (MAIN07 C5 P238-269), coercive collection from Alderp (I P115-162), stepping into a divine confrontation for the succubi (U019 P532-564), retaliation and leverage with Luna, and punitive responses to Wiz. C was rejected because no conflict selector is given and the motive balance is unresolved. E was rejected because the conflict set is multi-episode and located.

Located choices with stated reasons include refusing Wiz's depleted soul price, declining the court offer for a friend and treating contracts and fellow-devil standing as obligations; most of the moral analysis (coercion, consent, forgiveness on others' behalf) is the monograph's, not his deliberation. D was rejected because no weighing of competing moral claims by him is shown. NOT_ASSESSED was rejected because stated reasons are located.

The failed affect-producing joke and adjustment (MAIN07 C5), performed laughter, teasing of Kazuma, engineered humiliation of Alderp and Aqua and a taste for embarrassment, with the H3 and H4 classes kept from disposing of uncomfortable evidence. C was rejected because the play is described, not quoted. E was rejected because it recurs and is located.

The monograph declares seven MASK units with 2,862 BASE-TEXT slots and 327 MAIN07 slots as reception scopes rather than independent observations, and states that no exhaustive appearance census, reliability score or pristine holdout is asserted. C was rejected because Dust, Yorimichi and later main material are summarized and the evidence index is outside this set. E was rejected because the scopes are declared exactly.

Affirmative located limits: he says he does not see everything, divine light blocks a search (U013 P261-270), available foresight is left unused, the joke fails, Aqua damages his manifestation, commercial losses recur, Luna's bounty imposes costs he did not cancel, and four rival models fail on named cases. B was rejected because this is one artifact and several limits are summarized. D was rejected because these are located counterinstances rather than gaps.

Within-episode clocks are separated (proposal, attempt, performance, report and promise; the refused court job versus the later departure), and body collapse, a cracked mask, nearly losing a life and an explicit lost life are distinguished. C was rejected because there are no in-world dates, defaults or selectors. E was rejected because the distinctions are explicit and located.

scenario_readiness.note: Voice is a functional sketch with few exact forms. CONDITIONAL would license lines that are mostly invention around 我輩 and laughter; NOT_ASSESSED would ignore the located recipient contrasts. This bounds the evidence set, not Vanir's speech.

cross_scenario_scope.assumed_chronology: Any one named episode family (MASK origin, MAIN03, MAIN04, MAIN07, MASK shop episodes or later boundary checks through MAIN17); the NOT_READY judgment holds for each, and no later state is assumed.
cross_scenario_scope.interlocutor_relationship: Attested relations only: Wiz, Kazuma, Maxwell, Alderp, Iris, Luna, Yunyun, Leen, the succubi and Aqua, each in its located mix of service, leverage, attachment and antagonism.
setting_constraints: Source-world shop, guild, dungeon, noble household or royal settings, or a realistic brokerage transfer without supernatural surveillance
No completed dungeon, counted lives or performed future restitution

scenario_readiness.note: The monograph sketches a restrained transfer (privileged records, brokerage, theatrical negotiation, no supernatural surveillance) but supplies no operational rules, and its motive rankings are unresolved. CONDITIONAL would treat a paragraph of transfer guidance as a model; NOT_ASSESSED would ignore that affirmative guidance.
Shop life is analyzed as a set of pressures without located routines or rules. CONDITIONAL would invent the routine; NOT_ASSESSED would ignore the located shop and fee distinctions.
Few stated reasons and no shown weighing. CONDITIONAL would turn the monograph's moral reading into his procedure.
No romantic relation of Vanir's is analyzed; the widow's inference of romantic meaning is recorded only as not reciprocal commitment.

conditions: Merchant brokerage, shop pricing or financing negotiation of the narrated kinds only.
Foresight is limited, can be blocked or left unused, and is never treated as omniscience; without a privileged channel he must infer, ask or bluff.
Effective help can be costly to the counterpart and rewarding to him at once; presumptive handling is not prior permission.
Wiz, clients and officials keep their own skills, refusals and costs.
scenario_readiness.note: The MAIN07 transaction is analyzed step by step (presumptive packing, aligned-interest admission, disclosure of compensation burdens, financing that with Kazuma's assets equals the debt) and shop economics are treated as real constraints. READY was rejected because no rules exist and outcomes depend on others; NOT_READY was rejected because the brokerage procedure is located and bounded.

known_limits.statement: Mask, constructed body, possessed host and reconstituted manifestation are one subject; body collapse, a cracked mask, nearly losing a life and an explicit lost life are different observations, and no present reserve of lives is inferred.

His foresight is not omniscience: he says he does not see everything, divine light blocks a search, available sight can be deliberately unused, and Kazuma's belief that he need not read the documents is an interpretation.
The reviewed episodes do not isolate attachment from provider dependence, contractual pride from reputational interest, or pleasure from profit under forced tradeoffs.

Assistance can be effective, costly to the recipient and self-rewarding at once; the MAIN07 presumptive handling, possession and imposed terms remain coercive whatever the later gratitude, and Wiz cannot forgive on others' behalf.
The origin episode is Wiz's first person and the MAIN07 interlude Alderp's; neither grants access to Vanir's private calculations, and his own accounts remain attributed.
The completed dungeon, the whole punishment of Alderp and every forecast restitution are announced rather than performed, and seeking the court job does not show an appointment.
A realistic transfer must not acquire actual supernatural surveillance because a canonical line sounds confident.

The linked reconstruction model, the Vanir evidence index, readings, ledgers and the Japanese source are not curated on this subject and were not assessed; missing support is not evidence that any trait or capacity is absent.
